description: MULTIPLY a winning video ad into N variants: each gets a NEW character, outfit, location and/or objects while the cut, the camera motion, the pacing and the ORIGINAL AUDIO stay exactly as they were, and any burned-in captions are removed. Pass the source video URL (a render, job result, list_library, or the top performer from post_performance / meta_insights). HOW: motion transfer driven by the source from one image-edited opening frame, so length, cut and audio are the source's. Sources up to 30 seconds work as they are; longer ones are refused for free with the way out (trim it first: post_edit with ops [{op:'trim', start:0, end:30}] — clip_video is the AI highlight clipper, not a trim). ONE JOB PER VARIANT: get_job each until done; never describe a variant before its URL arrives. COST: quoteOnly:true returns the exact credits free: state that first. A paid planning read (planCredits) runs next, then each variant bills perVariantCredits. dryRun:true pays for that read; pass its `plan` back to render without paying again. images takes up to 9 of the user's product, people, clothes or places, and change names them @Image1, @Image2 in order ('she holds the bottle in @Image1'); the saved brand's product photo is read as a reference to its real look (useBrand:false leaves it out). No ad: list_winning_ads. New words: rewrite_ad_line. A TikTok, Reel, Facebook or X post link works as the source (not YouTube: upload the file): one paid lookup reads it into a file. quality: 1080p (default) or 720p; quoteOnly prices both. regions:['Berlin','Tokyo'] restyles per market; translation: dub_video on a finished variant. `change` is what should change, in the user's own words ('older women', 'winter streets'): every variant applies it and the variants still differ around it; a part of it about the voice, words, language, music, length or captions cannot change here, and the reply says so and names the tool that can.

axes.description: what to vary: character, outfit, location, objects (default all four), or your own, e.g. "season"

change.description: what should change, in the user's own words, e.g. 'older women, winter streets'; every variant applies it (omit to let the variants vary freely)

dryRun.description: true = the paid plan and the price, no render

images.description: up to 9 pictures to put in the variants, in the order @Image1, @Image2 name them: URLs or local paths

role.description: what it is, in your words, e.g. "our founder"

notes.description: anything the variants must respect, e.g. "keep it women 25-40", "no gyms"

plan.description: the `plan` a dryRun returned, rendered without planning again

quality.description: 1080p is the default; 720p costs less, and hands holding a product are less reliable at 720p

quoteOnly.description: true = the exact credits, free; nothing runs

regions.description: markets to restyle for, one or more variants each, e.g. ["Berlin","Tokyo","São Paulo"] — visuals only; audio is never translated here

start.description: instead of video: an id from list_winning_ads

useBrand.description: false = send no brand product photo (for a video that is not this workspace brand)

video.description: the source video: a file URL, or a TikTok, Reel, Facebook or X post link (not YouTube)

name: multiply_ad
title: Multiply an ad
